description: Every image displayed in README.md or docs/ is classified here. 'paper' exhibits are committed under papers/ with their own producers and frozen inputs and are never regenerated by documentation tooling. 'synthetic' exhibits are teaching figures generated by a producer module in this directory from the article's canonical worked example.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 8 responses; 4 factors.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.02 per month; nothing is annualised.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO, CVXPY with CLARABEL, no sign constraints, zero prior.
conventions.evaluation: In-sample residuals. Held-out evaluation belongs to LassoModelDiagonalityCV.

assets.alt: Residual eigenvalues against the Marchenko-Pastur edge, and sphericity against its threshold along a penalty grid, with and without one factor.

assets.study: JSS manuscript, Figure etf-credit: mean Credit loading of seventeen IG/HY/EM bond ETFs against normalised regularisation strength on the frozen 2017-2026 excess-return panel.
assets.alt: Mean Credit loading of bond ETFs against regularisation strength for shrink-to-zero HCGL, prior-centred HCGL and prior-centred FCGL.
